requirement: Implement StreamAnalyzer handling single-pass and multi-pass stream processing without generator exhaustion, with chunking and history resets.
skeleton: StreamAnalyzer class with compute_stats, filter_and_split, chunk_stream, and clear methods.

rationale.teaches: Single-pass iterables: materialize once before computing several aggregates, validate chunk_size, allow exactly 500 items, keep items the predicate accepts, and reset history on clear.
rationale.why: Consuming a generator twice does not raise; the second pass just sees nothing. The fixture passes a generator rather than a list so the exhaustion is observable as wrong statistics.

candidates.why_wrong: The stream is consumed by the count, so sum sees nothing and min and max are hardcoded to zero.
chunk_size of zero or less is accepted, so chunking loops forever or raises from range.
Exactly 500 items is rejected even though 500 is the documented limit.
The predicate is inverted, so filter_and_split keeps the rejected items and drops the accepted ones.
clear does not touch history, so results from earlier streams persist.
